docs.title: Fitur Utama Engine
docs.text:
• Penyimpanan Eksternal (No-Root)

    Bebas tambah, edit, atau hapus karakter kapan saja langsung di /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/ tanpa perlu bongkar atau rebuild file APK.

  • Declarative CPU AI Engine

    Pakai file .cpu buat atur inisiatif serangan, spacing neutral game, auto-guard reflek, dan hit-confirm combo lanjutan.

  • Support Assist / Striker

    Bisa tambah striker kustom yang bisa dipanggil saat match pertarungan menggunakan Qi meter.

  • Sistem Override Aman

    Bisa replace aset visual, BGM, atau AI petarung bawaan tanpa merusak file core game bawaan APK.

docs.title: Adding Custom Characters
docs.text: Official guide for deploying playable fighters, assist strikers, and adventure (Mosou) enemies into STARBLAST via Android storage (/sdcard/STARBLAST/).

docs.title: Quick Workflow (3 Steps)
docs.text:
Step 1: Create FolderStep 2: Copy AssetsStep 3: Register Character

Create a new character folder under the fighter directory: 

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<character_id>/
Use lowercase characters without spaces (e.g., vergil, sasuke_uchiha).

Drop the .swf animation file, character.json configuration, .png portraits, and .mp3 battle theme into the folder.

Open /sdcard/STARBLAST/character.conf and append the folder name under [character].

docs.title: Character Folder Structure
docs.text:
Each character folder in /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<name>/ contains the following files:

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<character_name>/
├── character.json          # [Required] Character metadata & parameters
├── fighter.swf             # [Required] ActionScript 3 (AVM2) Flash animation
├── face.png                # Small select grid icon (48x48 px)
├── face_big.png            # Standing portrait on character selection
├── face_bar.png            # Health bar portrait during battle
├── face_win.png            # Victory screen card artwork
├── theme.mp3               # Battle theme music (44.1 kHz stereo)
└── ai.cpu                  # Custom CPU AI behavioral profile

docs.title: character.json Configuration
docs.text:
Save the following JSON template as character.json inside your character folder:

{
  "id": "example_character",
  "name": "Cool Fighter",
  "swf": "example_character.swf",
  "start_frame": 1,
  "localcoord": "auto",

  "face": "face.png",
  "face_big": "face_big.png",
  "face_bar": "face_bar.png",
  "face_win": "face_win.png",

  "ai": "ai.cpu",
  "ai_level": 3,

  "bgm": "theme.mp3",
  "bgm_rate": 1.0,

  "says": [
    "Prepare to face true power!",
    "The real battle has just begun."
  ],

  "selectable": true
}

docs.title: Parameter Reference
docs.text: Parameter Type Required Default Description & Example id String Yes Folder name Unique identifier (lowercase & underscores, e.g. "vergil"). name String Yes Same as ID Display name rendered on the game UI. swf String Yes <id>.swf Flash SWF binary file containing animations. start_frame Int No 1 Starting sprite MovieClip frame. localcoord String No "auto" Local canvas coordinate system mode. face String No "face.png" Small selection icon. face_big String No Same as face Large portrait shown when highlighted. face_bar String No "" Small portrait next to the in-game health bar. face_win String No "" Round victory screen card artwork. ai String No "" CPU AI profile filename (e.g. "ai.cpu"). ai_level Int No 3 CPU difficulty (1=Easy, 2=Normal, 3=Hard, 4=Very Hard). bgm String No "" Character battle theme file (.mp3). bgm_rate Number No 1.0 Playback tempo multiplier (1.0 = normal). says Array No [] Voice/dialog quotes shown when selected. selectable Bool No true Set false to hide character from the select menu.

docs.title: Technical Asset Specifications
docs.text:
Animation Specifications (.swf)

  • Engine: ActionScript 3 (AVM2), Flash Player 11+ / AIR.
  • Frame Rate: Synchronized with engine (30 FPS or 60 FPS).
  • Standard Frame Labels: zhan (idle), zou (walk), pao (dash), tiao (jump), fangyu (guard), kan1-kan4 (normals), kj1/kj2 (skills), zh1-zh3 (specials), bs/sbs/cbs (finishers).

Graphic Specifications (.png)

  • Format: True RGBA 24-bit or 32-bit with transparency.
  • face.png: 48 x 48 px or 60 x 60 px (1:1 square).
  • face_big.png: 400 x 600 px up to 720 px max height.
  • face_bar.png: 80 x 80 px.
  • face_win.png: 200 x 300 px.

Audio Specifications (.mp3)

  • Format: MPEG-1 Audio Layer III (MP3).
  • Sample Rate: 44,100 Hz (44.1 kHz), 2-Channel Stereo.
  • Bitrate: Recommended 128 kbps (maximum 192 kbps).

docs.title: Registering in character.conf
docs.text:
Open /sdcard/STARBLAST/character.conf and register folder names under the appropriate section:

# STARBLAST character list

[character]
# Register playable fighter folder names below (one per line)
vergil
naruto_sage
sasuke_rinnegan

[mosou_enemy]
# Register adventure mode wave enemies below
zetsu_white

[assist]
# Register assist striker folder names below
itachi_assist
pain_assist

docs.title: Built-in APK Override Feature
docs.text:
External characters with the exact same folder name as a built-in character will automatically override that character.

Example: Overriding Built-in Vergil AI

To upgrade built-in Vergil's AI to Very Hard without touching his animation SWF or sprites, simply create: 

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/vergil/
└── ai.cpu
The game engine automatically loads Vergil's animations and portraits from the APK while overriding his AI behavior with your new ai.cpu profile.

docs.title: Assist Strikers
docs.text:
1. Create a folder at /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/assist/<assist_name>/.
  2. Drop the .swf animation file, face.png, and assist.json.
  3. Format of assist.json: 
    {
  "id": "itachi_assist",
  "name": "Itachi (Assist)",
  "swf": "itachi.swf",
  "face": "face.png"
}
  4. Register the folder name under [assist] in character.conf.

docs.text: Issue Cause & Solution Character not showing up 1. Folder not listed in character.conf.2. "selectable" is set to false.3. Trailing comma syntax error in character.json. Game crashes when selecting 1. SWF file corrupted or compiled in ActionScript 2.2. Missing required Flash symbol definitions. Face icon is blank or black box Image is a renamed JPG instead of true RGBA PNG with alpha channel. Battle theme does not play Bitrate exceeds limits or sample rate is not 44.1 kHz. CPU bot remains motionless Filename in "ai" field does not match the actual .cpu filename.

docs.title: Creating CPU AI Profiles (ai.cpu)
docs.text: Comprehensive specifications, configuration syntax, and behavior scripting rules for designing custom CPU artificial intelligence profiles in STARBLAST.

docs.title: AI Profile File Hierarchy (Single-Path Architecture)
docs.text: STARBLAST enforces a single-path loading system for CPU AI profiles. The engine strictly searches for the configuration file directly inside the character's own directory. Legacy global AI folders and external fallback scans have been completely deprecated.

docs.title: Directory Resolution Order:
docs.text:
1. External Mobile Storage (/sdcard/STARBLAST/):
  2. characters/fighter/<char_id>/ai.cpu (External / override fighters)
  3. SWF Parent Folder:
  4. Located directly alongside the fighter's .swf binary.
  5. Internal APK Assets (Built-in):
  6. assets/characters/fighter/<char_id>/ai.cpu

Target Filename

The standard canonical filename is ai.cpu. If a custom filename is specified in character.json via "ai": "custom.cpu", the engine checks that file first, but it must reside strictly within that character's folder.

docs.title: Basic .cpu File Structure
docs.text:
A .cpu file is divided into 4 core sections:

1. Section [AI]2. Section [Ranges]3. Section [Combo]4. Section [State -1]

Sets baseline psychology and movement parameters: 

[AI]
style = rushdown
preferred_spacing = 48
aggression = 1.45
defensiveness = 1.35

Defines horizontal boundaries ($X_{\text{min}}, X_{\text{max}}$ in pixels) for move activation: 

[Ranges]
attack = 0, 145
attackAIR = 0, 155
skill1 = 0, 240
skill2 = 0, 180
zhao1 = 40, 320
bisha = 0, 260
bishaSUPER = 0, 290

Defines standard combo sequences and cancellation windows: 

[Combo]
normal_chain = 砍1, 砍2, 砍3, 砍4, k5
cancel_chain = 砍2, 砍3, 砍4

Conditional tactical rules and smart move triggers: 

[State -1, HitConfirm_Skill1]
name = Kan3_To_RapidSlash
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b
trigger_dist_x = 0, 220
trigger_hit = true
action = skill1
priority = 285
chance = 0.95

docs.title: [AI] Parameter Reference
docs.text: Parameter Type Valid Values Description style String rushdown, aggressive, zoner, defensive, balanced Core combat behavior archetype. rushdown fighters aggressively close gaps with dash when $>170\text{px}$ and exert continuous offensive pressure up close. preferred_spacing Number 45 - 120 Ideal horizontal pixel distance maintained during neutral footsies. aggression Number Default 1.0 (e.g. 1.45) Offensive action frequency and dash initiative multiplier. defensiveness Number Default 1.0 (e.g. 1.35) Guard reaction sensitivity multiplier when enemy begins attack.

docs.title: Move & Action Mapping in [Ranges] & [State -1]
docs.text: Action BVN Button Description attack J Standing normal attack (kanmian). attackAIR Air J Aerial normal strike (tkanmian). skill1 U Projectile / special skill 1 (kj1mian). skill2 I Side skill / special skill 2 (kj2mian). zhao1 W + J Upward special strike / Anti-Air (zh1mian). zhao2 S + J Downward special strike (zh2mian). zhao3 W + U Follow-up upward special (zh3mian). skillAIR Air U Aerial special skill (tzmian). bisha I / U+I 1-Bar Qi Finisher Super (bsmian). bishaUP W + I Upward 1-Bar Qi Finisher (sbsmian). bishaSUPER S + I Full 3-Bar Qi Ultimate Finisher (cbsmian). assist O Summons chosen striker assist for tactical support attack. ghostStep L High-speed Flash Step / Shunpo invulnerable dodge. downJump S + K Air Recovery / Combo Break when hit or airborne. waiKai J + K Standard Transformation / Bankai / Awakening. waiKaiW W + J+K Upward variant Transformation / Awakening. waiKaiS S + J+K Downward variant Transformation / Awakening.

docs.title: Trigger Parameters ([State -1])
docs.text:
Each [State -1, Rule_Name] evaluates the following triggers before executing an action:

Parameter MUGEN Alias Type Description trigger_action stateno, curaction CSV Current running sprite frame label (e.g.: 砍1, 砍2, 跳砍). trigger_dist_x p2dist x Min, Max Target enemy horizontal distance in pixels. trigger_dist_y p2dist y Min, Max Target enemy vertical distance in pixels. trigger_hit movehit Boolean true only if previous attack connected (hit-confirm). trigger_qi power Integer Minimum required Qi meter (100 = 1 Bar, 300 = 3 Bars). trigger_energy energy Integer Minimum required stamina/dash energy (0 - 100). trigger_hp life, p1life Expr / Number Self remaining HP ratio (e.g.: < 0.3 or < 30 for Desperation). trigger_target_hp p2life Expr / Number Target remaining HP ratio (e.g.: < 0.2 or < 20 to execute finisher). trigger_target_air p2air 1 / -1 / Bool 1 if target is airborne, -1 if target is on ground. trigger_target_state p2state String / Int Target status: down (knockdown), guard (blocking), hurt, attack. p2movetype p2movetype String A if target opponent is currently executing an attack. cooldown cd, delay Integer Frame cooldown after triggering before rule can fire again (anti-spam). priority order Integer Execution priority (100 - 400). Values $\ge 250$ override generic AI decisions. chance rate Float Evaluation probability (0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 = guaranteed execution).

docs.title: Difficulty Scale ai_level in character.json
docs.text:
{
  "id": "vergil",
  "name": "Vergil",
  "swf": "vergil.swf",
  "ai": "ai.cpu",
  "ai_level": 4,
  "selectable": true
}
  • 1 : Easy — 3-frame reaction lag, danger radius 60px.
  • 2 : Normal — 2-frame reaction lag, danger radius 85px.
  • 3 : Hard — 1-frame reaction lag, predictive attack enabled.
  • 4 : Very Hard / Hell — 0-frame instant reaction, reactive auto-guard, maximum combo priority.

docs.title: Case Study: Vergil AI Profile (Very Hard)
docs.text:
Rules implemented in assets/characters/fighter/vergil/ai.cpu:

; 1. Cancel Normal Kan3 into Rapid Slash on Hit
[State -1, Cancel_Kan3_RapidSlash]
name = Yamato_Kan3_To_RapidSlash
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b
trigger_dist_x = 0, 220
trigger_hit = true
action = skill1
priority = 285
chance = 0.95

; 2. Air Rave Combo: Aerial Slash into Helm Breaker
[State -1, Air_Rave_HelmBreaker]
name = Air_Rave_Helm_Breaker
trigger_action = 跳砍, KJ1.5, KJ2, KJ3
trigger_dist_x = 0, 180
trigger_hit = true
action = skillAIR
priority = 310
chance = 0.98

; 3. Execute Judgement Cut End (1 Bar Qi)
[State -1, Super_JudgementCutEnd_HitConfirm]
name = Super_Judgement_Cut_End_Confirm
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b, 砍4, 砍技1, 招2
trigger_dist_x = 0, 250
trigger_qi = 100
trigger_hit = true
action = bisha
priority = 380
chance = 0.98

; 4. Reactive Guard when Opponent Attacks
[State -1, Reactive_Guard_VeryHard]
name = Yamato_Reactive_Guard
triggerall = p2movetype = A
trigger_dist_x = 0, 130
trigger_dist_y = -60, 60
action = defense
priority = 330
chance = 0.92

; 5. Desperation Ultimate: Sin Devil Trigger (BishaSUPER) when HP < 30% and Qi is Full (3 Bars)
[State -1, Desperation_SinDevilTrigger]
name = Desperation_SDT_Burst
trigger_hp = < 0.3
trigger_qi = 300
action = bishaSUPER
priority = 400
cooldown = 300
chance = 1.0

; 6. Okizeme Assist: Summon Striker when Opponent is Knocked Down
[State -1, Okizeme_Assist_Trap]
name = Striker_Okizeme_Trap
trigger_target_state = down
trigger_dist_x = 0, 160
action = assist
priority = 270
cooldown = 180
chance = 0.85

Fighters with Transformation / Bankai (waiKai)

Fighters such as Naruto (Nine-Tails / Sage Mode) or Ichigo (Bankai / Hollow) that feature form transformations (J+K) can use action = waiKai. For Vergil, Sin Devil Trigger is his 3-Bar Ultimate attack, which uses action = bishaSUPER.

docs.title: AI Tuning Tips
docs.text:
Always Use trigger_hit = true on Finisher Supers

Always apply trigger_hit = true to high-cost super moves (bisha, bishaSUPER). This prevents the CPU from wasting meter when earlier hits whiff.

Balance Rule Priorities

  • Super Finishers / Bisha: Priority 350 - 400
  • Hit-Confirm Cancels: Priority 260 - 300
  • Spacing / Neutral Harassment: Priority 200 - 240

docs.title: Guide Tambah Karakter Kustom
docs.text: Panduan cara pasang fighter baru, assist striker, dan musuh mode petualangan (Mosou) ke game STARBLAST via storage HP (/sdcard/STARBLAST/) tanpa perlu membongkar atau rebuild file APK.

docs.title: Quick Setup (3 Langkah Cepat)
docs.text:
1. Buat Folder2. Masukkan File Aset3. Daftarkan di Config

Bikin folder baru untuk fighter di dalam direktori: 

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<id_karakter>/
Gunakan huruf kecil semua tanpa spasi (contoh: vergil, sasuke_uchiha).

Copy file animasi .swf, config character.json, sprite portrait .png, dan audio .mp3 ke dalam folder tersebut.

Buka file /sdcard/STARBLAST/character.conf, lalu tambahkan nama folder fighter kalian di bawah section [character].

docs.title: Struktur Folder Fighter
docs.text:
Di dalam folder /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<nama_karakter>/, siapkan file-file berikut:

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/<nama_karakter>/
├── character.json          # [Wajib] Config data, nama, aset, dan parameter fighter
├── fighter.swf             # [Wajib] Animasi SWF ActionScript 3 (AVM2)
├── face.png                # Icon kecil di grid select screen (48x48 px)
├── face_big.png            # Standing portrait besar saat karakter di-hover/dipilih
├── face_bar.png            # Icon portrait di samping HP lifebar saat match
├── face_win.png            # Artwork kartu victory screen
├── theme.mp3               # BGM battle theme fighter (44.1 kHz stereo)
└── ai.cpu                  # Profil behavior CPU bot (opsional)

docs.title: Template character.json Siap Pakai
docs.text:
Tinggal buat file character.json di dalam folder fighter kalian, lalu paste template berikut:

{
  "id": "contoh_karakter",
  "name": "Karakter Keren",
  "swf": "contoh_karakter.swf",
  "start_frame": 1,
  "localcoord": "auto",

  "face": "face.png",
  "face_big": "face_big.png",
  "face_bar": "face_bar.png",
  "face_win": "face_win.png",

  "ai": "ai.cpu",
  "ai_level": 3,

  "bgm": "theme.mp3",
  "bgm_rate": 1.0,

  "says": [
    "Bersiaplah menghadapi kekuatanku!",
    "Pertarungan yang sesungguhnya baru saja dimulai."
  ],

  "selectable": true
}

docs.title: Parameter Reference
docs.text: Parameter Tipe Wajib Default Keterangan & Contoh id String Ya Nama folder ID unik fighter (lowercase & underscore, misal: "vergil"). name String Ya Sama dgn ID Nama display yang muncul di UI / select screen. swf String Ya <id>.swf File animasi SWF ActionScript 3. start_frame Int Tidak 1 Frame awal MovieClip saat karakter di-spawn. localcoord String Tidak "auto" Koordinat canvas (biarkan "auto"). face String Tidak "face.png" Icon kecil di grid select screen. face_big String Tidak Sama dgn face Standing portrait besar waktu fighter di-select. face_bar String Tidak "" Icon portrait kecil di samping HP lifebar. face_win String Tidak "" Artwork display di victory screen. ai String Tidak "" File profil AI CPU (misal: "ai.cpu"). ai_level Int Tidak 3 Difficulty level CPU (1=Easy, 2=Normal, 3=Hard, 4=Very Hard/Hell). bgm String Tidak "" File BGM tema battle fighter (.mp3). bgm_rate Number Tidak 1.0 Playback speed BGM (1.0 = normal). says Array Tidak [] Voice quote text saat fighter dipilih. selectable Bool Tidak true Set false jika ingin menyembunyikan fighter dari roster (contoh: secret boss).

docs.title: Standar Format Aset
docs.text:
Agar performa game tetap smooth dan bebas crash/force close di perangkat Android:

Animasi SWF (.swf)

  • Engine: ActionScript 3 (AVM2), Flash Player 11+ / AIR runtime.
  • Framerate: Sinkron dengan setting game (30 FPS atau 60 FPS).
  • Standard Frame Labels: zhan (idle/stand), zou (walk), pao (run/dash), tiao (jump), fangyu (guard), kan1-kan4 (normal attack chain), kj1/kj2 (skills), zh1-zh3 (specials), bs/sbs/cbs (super/finisher).

Sprite & Artwork (.png)

  • Format: True PNG RGBA (dengan alpha channel transparansi).
  • face.png: 48 x 48 px atau 60 x 60 px (rasio 1:1 kotak).
  • face_big.png: 400 x 600 px hingga tinggi maksimal 720 px (canvas 1280x720).
  • face_bar.png: 80 x 80 px (icon status bar).
  • face_win.png: 200 x 300 px (portrait victory).

Audio BGM (.mp3)

  • Format: MP3 (MPEG-1 Audio Layer III).
  • Sample Rate: 44.100 Hz (44.1 kHz), Stereo 2-Channel.
  • Bitrate: Disarankan 128 kbps (maksimal 192 kbps agar hemat RAM).

docs.title: Mendaftarkan Karakter di character.conf
docs.text:
Buka file /sdcard/STARBLAST/character.conf menggunakan text editor di HP (MT Manager, QuickEdit, ACode, dll.), lalu daftarkan nama folder karakter kalian:

# STARBLAST character roster

[character]
# Tulis nama folder fighter di sini (satu baris satu nama)
vergil
naruto_sage
sasuke_rinnegan

[mosou_enemy]
# Tulis musuh petualangan Mosou di sini
zetsu_white

[assist]
# Tulis nama folder striker/assist di sini
itachi_assist
pain_assist

docs.title: Override Fighter Bawaan APK
docs.text:
Kalian bisa mengganti animasi, BGM tema, maupun tuning AI dari fighter bawaan APK tanpa perlu membongkar file APK.

Cukup buat folder di /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/ dengan nama ID yang persis sama dengan fighter bawaan APK.

Contoh: Bikin AI Vergil Jadi Very Hard Tanpa Ubah SWF

Jika kalian hanya ingin meng-upgrade AI Vergil bawaan APK jadi super jago tanpa mengganti file animasi SWF atau portrait-nya, cukup buat folder: 

/sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/fighter/vergil/
└── ai.cpu
Engine game akan otomatis memuat animasi SWF dan portrait Vergil langsung dari dalam APK, sedangkan script AI CPU-nya akan di-override menggunakan file ai.cpu kalian.

docs.title: Pasang Karakter Assist (Striker)
docs.text:
Karakter assist / striker dipanggil sesaat untuk melancarkan serangan bantuan saat Qi meter mencukupi, sehingga tidak memerlukan file AI (ai.cpu).

  1. Buat folder di /sdcard/STARBLAST/characters/assist/<nama_assist>/.
  2. Masukkan file animasi .swf, icon face.png, dan file config assist.json.
  3. Format assist.json: 
    {
  "id": "itachi_assist",
  "name": "Itachi (Assist)",
  "swf": "itachi.swf",
  "face": "face.png"
}
  4. Daftarkan nama foldernya di bawah section [assist] pada file character.conf.

docs.title: Troubleshooting & Solusi Error
docs.text: Kendala Penyebab Umum & Solusi Karakter tidak muncul di select screen 1. Nama folder belum didaftarkan di character.conf di bawah [character].2. Di character.json, pastikan "selectable": true.3. Cek sintaks JSON, hindari koma berlebih (trailing comma) di baris terakhir. Force Close saat memilih karakter 1. File SWF corrupt atau masih ActionScript 2 (engine wajib ActionScript 3 / AVM2).2. Missing MovieClip linkage atau symbol Flash di dalam SWF. Gambar portrait blank / hitam File bukan PNG transparan asli (contoh: file JPG yang di-rename jadi .png). Wajib re-export sebagai format PNG 32-bit dengan alpha channel. BGM battle theme tidak berbunyi Bitrate MP3 terlalu tinggi atau sample rate bukan 44.1 kHz stereo. Bot CPU idle / diam saja Nama file di property "ai" tidak matching dengan nama file .cpu di folder fighter.

docs.title: Guide AI CPU (ai.cpu)
docs.text: Panduan lengkap bikin dan tuning behavior AI bot untuk fighter di STARBLAST pakai format .cpu deklaratif.

docs.title: Jalur Loading File AI (1 Path Folder Fighter)
docs.text: STARBLAST menerapkan sistem 1 jalur tunggal untuk loading file AI CPU. Engine langsung membaca file konfigurasi AI di dalam folder fighter masing-masing. Tidak ada lagi scan folder global atau fallback terpisah.

docs.title: Prioritas Resolusi:
docs.text:
1. External Storage (/sdcard/STARBLAST/):
  2. characters/fighter/<char_id>/ai.cpu (Mod / override fighter eksternal)
  3. Parent Folder SWF:
  4. Lokasi file ai.cpu tepat di samping file .swf fighter.
  5. Built-in Assets APK:
  6. assets/characters/fighter/<char_id>/ai.cpu

Nama File AI

Nama file standar adalah ai.cpu. Kalau di character.json kalian set nama custom via "ai": "custom.cpu", engine bakal prioritaskan nama file tersebut, tapi wajib tetap berada di dalam folder fighter yang sama. (Assist / striker tidak memerlukan file AI).

docs.title: 4 Bagian Utama File .cpu
docs.text:
Format file .cpu dibagi ke dalam 4 section:

1. Section [AI]2. Section [Ranges]3. Section [Combo]4. Section [State -1]

Menentukan playstyle dasar dan behavior bot: 

[AI]
style = rushdown
preferred_spacing = 48
aggression = 1.45
defensiveness = 1.35

Menentukan jarak horizontal ($X_{\text{min}}, X_{\text{max}}$ dalam pixel) kapan move/skill boleh dieksekusi: 

[Ranges]
attack = 0, 145
attackAIR = 0, 155
skill1 = 0, 240
skill2 = 0, 180
zhao1 = 40, 320
bisha = 0, 260
bishaSUPER = 0, 290

Menentukan normal chain combo dan cancel window ke skill: 

[Combo]
normal_chain = 砍1, 砍2, 砍3, 砍4, k5
cancel_chain = 砍2, 砍3, 砍4

Conditional rules untuk eksekusi taktis (hit-confirm, auto-guard, atau punish): 

[State -1, HitConfirm_Skill1]
name = Kan3_To_RapidSlash
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b
trigger_dist_x = 0, 220
trigger_hit = true
action = skill1
priority = 285
chance = 0.95

docs.title: Setting Parameter [AI]
docs.text: Parameter Tipe Value Valid Keterangan style String rushdown, aggressive, zoner, defensive, balanced Playstyle archetype utama. Tipe rushdown bakal agresif dash ngejar musuh saat jarak jauh ($>170\text{px}$) dan kasih pressure konstan waktu close range. preferred_spacing Number 45 - 120 Jarak horizontal ideal (pixel) yang dijaga bot saat neutral game / footsies. aggression Number Default 1.0 (misal: 1.45) Multiplier frekuensi serangan dan inisiatif dash forward. defensiveness Number Default 1.0 (misal: 1.35) Multiplier reflek tangkisan (guard) saat lawan start animasi attack.

docs.title: Move Mapping & Action di [Ranges] & [State -1]
docs.text: Action Tombol Default Deskripsi attack J Normal ground attack (kanmian). attackAIR Air J Normal aerial attack (tkanmian). skill1 U Skill 1 / projectile jarak jauh (kj1mian). skill2 I Skill 2 forward / thrust cepat (kj2mian). zhao1 W + J Special up attack / Anti-Air (zh1mian). zhao2 S + J Special down attack (zh2mian). zhao3 W + U Special up followup (zh3mian). skillAIR Air U Special move di udara (tzmian). bisha I / U+I Super Finisher 1 Bar Qi (bsmian). bishaUP W + I Up Super Finisher 1 Bar Qi (sbsmian). bishaSUPER S + I Ultimate Finisher 3 Bar Qi (cbsmian). assist O Memanggil karakter bantuan / striker untuk support attack. ghostStep L Flash step / Shunpo dodge berkecepatan tinggi (makan energy). downJump S + K Air Recovery / Combo Break saat terlempar atau jatuh. waiKai J + K Transformasi / Awakening / Bankai standar. waiKaiW W + J+K Transformasi / Awakening varian atas. waiKaiS S + J+K Transformasi / Awakening varian bawah.

docs.title: Trigger Conditions [State -1]
docs.text:
Setiap block [State -1, Nama_Rule] mengevaluasi trigger conditions berikut sebelum menembakkan action:

Parameter MUGEN Alias Tipe Deskripsi trigger_action stateno, curaction CSV Nama frame animation aktif (contoh: 砍1, 砍2, 跳砍, 瞬步). trigger_dist_x p2dist x Min, Max Jarak horizontal (pixel) ke musuh. trigger_dist_y p2dist y Min, Max Jarak vertikal (pixel) ke musuh (nilai minus = musuh di atas). trigger_hit movehit Boolean true jika serangan sebelumnya confirmed kena musuh (Hit-Confirm). trigger_qi power Integer Syarat minimal Qi meter (100 = 1 Bar, 300 = 3 Bar). trigger_energy energy Integer Syarat minimal dash/stamina meter (0 s/d 100). trigger_hp life, p1life Expr / Number Sisa HP bot sendiri (misal: < 0.3 atau < 30 untuk Desperation Mode). trigger_target_hp p2life Expr / Number Sisa HP musuh (misal: < 0.2 atau < 20 untuk execute finisher). trigger_target_air p2air 1 / -1 / Bool 1 jika musuh sedang melayang di udara, -1 jika musuh di darat. trigger_target_state p2state String / Int Status musuh: down (jatuh), guard (tangkis), hurt (terpukul), attack (menyerang). p2movetype p2movetype String A jika musuh lagi menyerang (dipakai untuk Auto-Guard). cooldown cd, delay Integer Durasi jeda frame sebelum rule boleh dieksekusi lagi (anti-spam). priority order Integer Prioritas eksekusi (100 - 400). Nilai $\ge 250$ akan override AI bawaan. chance rate Float Peluang trigger (0.0 s/d 1.0; 1.0 = 100% pasti tembak).

docs.title: Tingkat Kesulitan AI di character.json
docs.text:
Di character.json, kalian bisa set parameter "ai_level":

{
  "id": "vergil",
  "name": "Vergil",
  "swf": "vergil.swf",
  "ai": "ai.cpu",
  "ai_level": 4,
  "selectable": true
}
  • 1 : Easy — Delay reaksi bot 3 frame, jarak reflek 60px.
  • 2 : Normal — Delay reaksi bot 2 frame, jarak reflek 85px.
  • 3 : Hard — Delay reaksi 1 frame, predictive attack aktif.
  • 4 : Very Hard / Hell — Respon 0 frame instan tanpa jeda, auto-guard reflek aktif, cadence combo 32% lebih kencang.

docs.title: Contoh Setup: AI Vergil (Very Hard)
docs.text:
Snippet rule nyata dari file assets/characters/fighter/vergil/ai.cpu:

; 1. Cancel Normal Kan3 ke Rapid Slash saat Serangan Kena (Hit-Confirm)
[State -1, Cancel_Kan3_RapidSlash]
name = Yamato_Kan3_To_RapidSlash
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b
trigger_dist_x = 0, 220
trigger_hit = true
action = skill1
priority = 285
chance = 0.95

; 2. Air Rave Combo: Tebasan Udara sambung Helm Breaker
[State -1, Air_Rave_HelmBreaker]
name = Air_Rave_Helm_Breaker
trigger_action = 跳砍, KJ1.5, KJ2, KJ3
trigger_dist_x = 0, 180
trigger_hit = true
action = skillAIR
priority = 310
chance = 0.98

; 3. Super Move: Judgement Cut End (1 Bar Qi Confirm)
[State -1, Super_JudgementCutEnd_HitConfirm]
name = Super_Judgement_Cut_End_Confirm
trigger_action = 砍3, k3b, 砍4, 砍技1, 招2
trigger_dist_x = 0, 250
trigger_qi = 100
trigger_hit = true
action = bisha
priority = 380
chance = 0.98

; 4. Auto-Guard Reflek saat Musuh Melancarkan Serangan
[State -1, Reactive_Guard_VeryHard]
name = Yamato_Reactive_Guard
triggerall = p2movetype = A
trigger_dist_x = 0, 130
trigger_dist_y = -60, 60
action = defense
priority = 330
chance = 0.92

; 5. Desperation Ultimate: Sin Devil Trigger (BishaSUPER) saat HP < 30% dan Qi Penuh (3 Bar)
[State -1, Desperation_SinDevilTrigger]
name = Desperation_SDT_Burst
trigger_hp = < 0.3
trigger_qi = 300
action = bishaSUPER
priority = 400
cooldown = 300
chance = 1.0

; 6. Okizeme Assist: Panggil Striker saat Musuh Jatuh (Knockdown)
[State -1, Okizeme_Assist_Trap]
name = Striker_Okizeme_Trap
trigger_target_state = down
trigger_dist_x = 0, 160
action = assist
priority = 270
cooldown = 180
chance = 0.85

Karakter dengan Transformasi / Bankai (waiKai)

Karakter seperti Naruto (Kyuubi / Sage Mode) atau Ichigo (Bankai / Hollow) yang memiliki mekanisme perubahan wujud (tombol J+K) bisa menggunakan action = waiKai. Pada Vergil, Sin Devil Trigger merupakan jurus Ultimate 3 Bar Qi, sehingga menggunakan action = bishaSUPER.

docs.title: Tips Bikin AI yang Kompetitif
docs.text:
Wajib Gunakan trigger_hit = true pada Finisher

Selalu pasang trigger_hit = true di rule move yang mengonsumsi Qi meter (bisha, bishaSUPER). Ini mencegah bot buang-buang bar Qi waktu serangan normalnya luput (whiff).

Panduan Set Priority

  • Super Finisher / Ultimate: Set priority 350 - 400
  • Combo Cancel / Hit-Confirm: Set priority 260 - 300
  • Neutral Spacing & Harassment: Set priority 200 - 240
